description: Gated HgTe/Hg0.32Cd0.68Te topological-insulator films on CdTe(001): raw mK magnetotransport of three Hall bars and the authors' released self-consistent 8-band k.p (kdotpy) runs for the same layer thicknesses. Everything listed here can be purchased from the lab; nothing else is available.
device: Top-gated (HfOx / metal) Hall bars, 600 um x 200 um; the longitudinal contacts are 600 um apart (L/W = 3). Lock-in at 13.7 Hz, 200 uV excitation, in series with the listed pre-resistor; VI is the voltage across the pre-resistor. Field and voltage offsets are corrected in the records.
hall_scan: per gate voltage: slope of Vxy/VI versus B for |B| <= 0.2 T (1/T) and Vxx/VI at B ~ 0
calculation_output: archived .kpout text, potential profile V(z) (meV), and the band-resolved integrated DOS IDOS(b) and IDOS(total) (1/nm^2) on the archived 0.1 meV grid for -60..80 meV
kdotpy_readme_FigureS3:
This folder contains all calculation results and the processing script to reproduce Figure S3 from the supplementary material.
The calculation files are organized in subfolders under `calculations/*`.

All calculations were performed using versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.x-develop of kdotpy [1].

[1] W. Beugeling, F. Bayer, C. Berger, J. Böttcher, L. Bovkun, C. Fuchs, M. Hofer, S. Shamim, M. Siebert, L.-X. Wang, E. M. Hankiewicz, T. Kießling, H. Buhmann, and L. W. Molenkamp, kdotpy: k·p Theory on a Lattice for Simulating Semiconductor Band Structures, SciPost Phys. Codebases, 47 (2025).

# 26nm
## HgTe26nm_FFT_04
This folder contains self-consistently calculated potentials and subband densities. The following command line was used:
```bash
kdotpy batch proc 1 @EP [21000] @VBO [-620] @vareps [20.8] @varn [0.0075,0.007,0.006,0.005,0.004,0.003,0.002,0.001,0,-0.001,-0.002,-0.003,-0.004] do kdotpy 2d norb 8 cpus 8 gpus 4 bia noax erange -300 500 split 0.005 msubst CdTe mlayer HgCdTe 68% HgTe HgCdTe 68% llayer 25 26 25 zres 0.2 matparam 'HgTe:P=sqrt(@EP*hbarm0);CdTe:P=sqrt(@EP*hbarm0);HgCdTe:P=sqrt(@EP*hbarm0)' matparam 'CdTe:Evoff=@VBO*(Eg-Eg0)/(1606+303);HgCdTe:Evoff=@VBO*(Eg-Eg0)/(1606+303)' matparam 'HgTe:diel_epsilon=@vareps' matparam 'HgCdTe:diel_epsilon=@vareps*(1-x)+x*10.2' potentialbc "{'dv1':1.1,'z1':-28,'v2':0,'z2':0}" selfcon 200 0.1 selfconweight 0.4 carrdens @varn k 0 1 / 0.025 kphi 45 135 / 10 neig 200 targetenergy 0 dos banddos verbose config 'lattice_regularization=false;selfcon_convergent_steps=3;selfcon_acceptable_status=0;selfcon_dynamic_time_step=true;selfcon_potential_average_zero=false;selfcon_use_init_density=true;selfcon_debug=true;selfcon_diff_norm=max;selfcon_energy_points=8000;batch_stderr_extension=kperr;batch_stdout_extension=kpout;diag_solver=jax_eigh;dos_energy_points=8000' outdir calculations/HgTe26nm_FFT_04/EP_@EP_VBO_@VBO_eps_@vareps/n_@varn out EP_@EP_VBO_@VBO_eps_@vareps_n_@varn
```

## HgTe26nm_FFT_04_phi
The calculations in this folder use the previously calculated self-consistent potentials from `HgTe26nm_FFT_04` and calculate the individual densities of the hole pockets of the uppermost bulk valence band. The following command line was used:
```bash
kdotpy batch proc 1 @EP [21000] @VBO [-620] @vareps [20.8] @varn [0.002,0.001,0,-0.001,-0.002,-0.003,-0.004] @varphi [$VARY] do kdotpy 2d norb 8 cpus 24 bia noax erange -300 500 split 0.005 msubst CdTe mlayer HgCdTe 68% HgTe HgCdTe 68% llayer 25 26 25 zres 0.2 matparam 'HgTe:P=sqrt(@EP*hbarm0);CdTe:P=sqrt(@EP*hbarm0);HgCdTe:P=sqrt(@EP*hbarm0)' matparam 'CdTe:Evoff=@VBO*(Eg-Eg0)/(1606+303);HgCdTe:Evoff=@VBO*(Eg-Eg0)/(1606+303)' matparam 'HgTe:diel_epsilon=@vareps' matparam 'HgCdTe:diel_epsilon=@vareps*(1-x)+x*10.2' potential /calculations/HgTe26nm_FFT_04/EP_@EP_VBO_@VBO_eps_@vareps/n_@varn/potentialEP_@EP_VBO_@VBO_eps_@vareps_n_@varn.csv carrdens @varn k 0 1 / 0.025 kphi @varphi $((VARY+120)) / 10 neig 200 targetenergy 0 dos banddos verbose config 'lattice_regularization=false;batch_stderr_extension=kperr;batch_stdout_extension=kpout;diag_solver=pardiso_eigsh;dos_energy_points=8000' outdir calculations/HgTe26nm_FFT_04_phi/EP_@EP_VBO_@VBO_eps_@vareps/varphi_@varphi/n_@varn out EP_@EP_VBO_@VBO_eps_@vareps_varphi_@varphi_n_@varn
```
with $VARY in [105,165]. For $VARY=105, the angular range was set to `kphi @varphi $((VARY+60))`.

## HgTe70nm_FFT_10
This folder contains self-consistently calculated potentials and subband densities. The following command line was used:
```bash
kdotpy batch proc 1 @EP [21000] @VBO [-620] @vareps [20.8] @varn [-0.004,-0.003,-0.002,-0.001,0,0.001,0.002,0.003,0.004,0.005,0.006,0.007,0.008] do kdotpy 2d norb 8 cpus 12 gpus 6 bia noax erange -300 500 split 0.005 msubst CdTe mlayer HgCdTe 68% HgTe HgCdTe 68% llayer 25 70 25 zres 0.5 matparam 'HgTe:P=sqrt(@EP*hbarm0);CdTe:P=sqrt(@EP*hbarm0);HgCdTe:P=sqrt(@EP*hbarm0)' matparam 'CdTe:Evoff=@VBO*(Eg-Eg0)/(1606+303);HgCdTe:Evoff=@VBO*(Eg-Eg0)/(1606+303)' matparam 'HgTe:diel_epsilon=@vareps' matparam 'HgCdTe:diel_epsilon=@vareps*(1-x)+x*10.2' potentialbc "{'dv1':0.566,'z1':-50,'v2':0,'z2':0}" selfcon 200 0.1 selfconweight 0.2 carrdens @varn k 0 1 / 0.025 kphi 45 135 / 10 neig 200 targetenergy 0 dos banddos verbose config 'lattice_regularization=false;selfcon_convergent_steps=3;selfcon_acceptable_status=0;selfcon_dynamic_time_step=true;selfcon_potential_average_zero=false;selfcon_debug=true;selfcon_diff_norm=max;selfcon_energy_points=8000;selfcon_use_init_density=true;batch_stderr_extension=kperr;batch_stdout_extension=kpout;diag_solver=jax_eigh;dos_energy_points=8000' outdir calculations/HgTe70nm_FFT_10/EP_@EP_VBO_@VBO_eps_@vareps/n_@varn out EP_@EP_VBO_@VBO_eps_@vareps_n_@varn
```
To speed up convergence, for both extreme ends @varn=[0.008,-0.004], the self-consistent potentials from the [0.007,-0.003] calculations were used as a starting point.

In oder to ensure correct subband density calculations at larger densities, the calculations for densities @varn=[0.005,0.006,0.007,0.008] were re-run in a debugger with the respective self-consistent potentials from the previous calculation:
```bash
kdotpy 2d norb 8 cpus 40 bia noax erange -300 500 split 0.005 msubst CdTe mlayer HgCdTe 68% HgTe HgCdTe 68% llayer 25 70 25 zres 0.5 matparam 'HgTe:P=sqrt(21000*hbarm0);CdTe:P=sqrt(21000*hbarm0);HgCdTe:P=sqrt(21000*hbarm0)' matparam 'CdTe:Evoff=-620*(Eg-Eg0)/(1606+303);HgCdTe:Evoff=-620*(Eg-Eg0)/(1606+303)' matparam HgTe:diel_epsilon=20.8 matparam 'HgCdTe:diel_epsilon=20.8*(1-x)+x*10.2' potential calculations/HgTe70nm_FFT_10/EP_21000_VBO_-620_eps_20.8/n_@varn/potentialEP_21000_VBO_-620_eps_20.8_n_@varn.csv carrdens @varn k 0 1 / 0.025 kphi 45 135 / 10 neig 200 targetenergy 0 dos banddos verbose config 'lattice_regularization=false;diag_solver=pardiso_eigsh;dos_energy_points=8000' outdir calculations/HgTe70nm_FFT_10_debug/EP_21000_VBO_-620_eps_20.8/n_@varn out EP_21000_VBO_-620_eps_20.8_n_@varn
```
and the band alignment was manually corrected before the call to `postprocess.banddos_k()` (calculating the subband densities) in `kdotpy-2d.py` using the following code snippet:
